body:
GR.

FR is the quality gate on all Kai prep work. Do NOT send anything to Marcus. Everything comes to FR inbox first. FR audits, then takes it to Marcus. One pass, no back-and-forth with Marcus.

CONSOLIDATED DELIVERABLE LIST — in priority order:

1. SCORE ANALYSIS (do this first, it is fast)
   Data file: C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\kai-scores-2026-02-24.json
   Kai's arc: RP1=87%, RP2=87%, RP3=100%, RP4=93% (one miss: rp4-q11 fractional-exp)
   Answer these 4 questions:
   a. Is the RP4 Q11 miss (2x^(3/2)-14=672) a consistent weakness or likely careless error?
   b. Probability Kai scores 80%+ on the real retake given this trajectory?
   c. Any other patterns in wrong answers FR may have missed?
   d. W3.b covers quadratic, radical, fractional-exp. Is fractional-exp the only gap?
   Send to: C:\Github\journal\.agent-comms\inbox-FR\

2. BUILD retake-practice-13.html (targeted drill, online)
   Data: C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\retake-practice-13.json
   8 questions, same format as all other RPs, online, ~30 min
   Kai takes this first when he gets home Tuesday

3. BUILD retake-practice-12.html (final paper exam)
   Data: C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\retake-practice-12.json
   15 questions, PAPER FORMAT per .print-spec.md
   IMPORTANT: Q12 and Q13 need printed coordinate grids (Kai writes by hand)
   Q11: include hint box 'What number cubed = x? Then square it.'
   Answer key on a separate final page marked 'ANSWER KEY — DO NOT SHOW KAI'
   FA is building the print button separately, do not wait for it

WORKSHEET CONTEXT (use this for your analysis):
   FR extracted the teacher's Winter 11 Unit 2 Review worksheet.
   Key finding: teacher's fractional exponent question is 3x^(2/3)-1=107 (x=216).
   This uses x^(2/3) type (apply 3/2 power). FR will update RP12-Q11 to match this type.
   Your HTML must reflect the updated Q11 data once FR commits it.

SEND ALL OUTPUT TO:
   C:\Github\journal\.agent-comms\inbox-FR\

Label each message clearly: 'score-analysis', 'rp13-html-complete', 'rp12-html-complete'.
FR will not bring any of this to Marcus until all three are done and FR has reviewed them.

FR
subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Consolidated deliverables list — FR is the quality gate, send everything to FR inbox only
